Technical leaders

Too many interviews with the wrong candidates

An engineer interviews every candidate before you see their CV, so your team only meets people who can do the job.

  1. Home
  2. Technical leaders

The challenge

Challenges we solve

  • Recruiters who don’t know the work

    You explain the role twice, and still receive candidates who confuse similar-sounding stacks or specialisms.

  • Interview hours lost

    Your senior engineers spend hours interviewing people who can’t do the job, time taken from delivery.

  • A project peak with no capacity

    A new contract or deadline needs skills your team doesn’t have right now, and a permanent hire would take too long.

  • Juniors who need months of training

    Graduates arrive with good theory, but your seniors spend months teaching them the tools before they contribute.

Our services

Services for your team

  • Acquire

    Talent acquisition

    Every candidate passes a technical interview run by an engineer before you see their CV.

  • Bridge

    Temporary staffing

    Vetted independent specialists who can contribute to a project phase quickly, without a permanent hire.

  • Map

    Competence mapping

    See where your team is strong and where it is thin, competence by competence, and design teams and hires around it.

  • Develop

    University talent programme

    Juniors selected through practical tasks reviewed by engineers and trained on the tools your team uses.

  • Secure

    Succession planning

    Continuity for technical leadership and a plan to transfer know-how before a key person leaves.

How we work

How we work with you

  1. 01

    Technical brief

    With you, we define the role, the stack or specialism, and the competences the technical interview must test.

    Typical duration
    2–3 working days

  2. 02

    Search

    We search our network and the wider market, including engineers who are not actively looking.

    Typical duration
    2–3 weeks

  3. 03

    Technical interview

    An engineer who knows the discipline interviews every candidate against the agreed competences.

    Typical duration
    1–2 weeks

  4. 04

    Shortlist with assessments

    You receive a small number of candidates, each with a written technical assessment, so your interviews start from evidence.

    Typical duration
    3–5 working days

  5. 05

    Your interviews and team fit

    You run your interview loop with vetted candidates only. We gather feedback on both sides and support the offer.

    Typical duration
    2–3 weeks

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Who runs the technical screening, and what do they test?

Engineers who know the discipline. They test the competences you agreed in the brief through a structured technical interview, and you receive their written assessment with each profile.

How fast can you get someone in for a project?

An independent professional can typically start 2 to 3 weeks after the brief, depending on the profile and how specialised the skills are. Tell us your timeline, and we will say straight away whether we can meet it.

Do independent specialists integrate with the team?

We assess their skills and their project experience before you meet them, and you choose who to engage. Each engagement has a scope and deliverables agreed before work starts, so everyone knows what the specialist owns.

Do graduates from your programme know our tools?

The training phase is built around the tools and practices your roles require, and participants are selected through practical tasks reviewed by engineers.

Can you show us where our team’s skill gaps are?

Yes. Competence mapping gives you a skills matrix for each team in scope and a gap analysis that separates gaps to hire for, gaps to train for and single points of failure.
